faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How quickly is the server activated?
faq.a1: Server activates instantly after payment. You can start playing in 2-3 minutes.
faq.a2: Yes, you can change the plan anytime in your personal account. Additional payment is proportional.
faq.a3: We support all popular versions from 1.16 to the latest version, including modded builds.
faq.q4: How does the payout system work?
faq.a4: Payouts happen weekly to bank card or electronic wallet. Minimum amount is 500₽.
